description: Gives each column of a track's sheet the date or number format its schema promises (dates as dates, money with two decimals), for the rows already there as well as new ones, and takes bold off the rows below the header. Use it when dates or times show as plain numbers like 46334 or 46334.43681, or after publish_schema changed a field's format. Values aren't changed. Google Sheets only.
name: format_sheet
title: Format a track's sheet
